display.purpose: Used for main campaign note headers and page titles.

headline.purpose: Used for H1 headings in Markdown note bodies.

title.purpose: Used for section labels, card headers, and toolbar titles.

body.purpose: Used for paragraph content, editor text, and list descriptions.

label.purpose: Used for tabs, tags, active states, and code blocks.

shadows.name: floating-overlay
shadows.purpose: Used only for context menus, autocomplete listings, and settings modals.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transitions for element hovers and tabs.

sizeScale.name: inline
sizeScale.purpose: Toolbar buttons and small action labels.

sizeScale.name: tree
sizeScale.purpose: Folder and note-type icons in sidebar trees.

icons.color: Inherit surrounding text colour (var(--fg) / var(--muted) for inactive). Never hard-code icon colours.
rules: Never use emoji or platform glyphs as UI icons (they render as colour-filled and vary per platform).
Never use solid/filled icon styles (e.g. lucide fill="currentColor" or Material filled) — wireframe/outline only.
No custom drawn SVG icons for chrome; if a glyph does not exist in lucide, pick the closest semantic stroke icon.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid primary action button with terracotta rust background and white text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--accent, oklch(52% 0.10 28)); color: white; padding: 6px 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 510; border: none; border-radius: 0px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--accent-hover, oklch(45% 0.12 28)); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Standard outline button for default or neutral actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--fg, oklch(20% 0.018 70)); padding: 6px 14px; font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 510; border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(90% 0.006 95)); border-radius: 0px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--border, oklch(90% 0.006 95)); }

components.name: Card Container
components.description: Flat card surface used to group details or items.

components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, oklch(100% 0.002 95)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(90% 0.006 95)); padding: 16px; border-radius: 0px; box-shadow: none; } .ds-card-title { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--fg); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-card-desc { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: var(--fg); background: var(--bg, oklch(98% 0.004 95)); border: 1px solid var(--border, oklch(90% 0.006 95)); padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 0px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent, oklch(52% 0.10 28)); }

components.name: Monospace Tab Button
components.description: Mono-spaced text button used in sidebars and inspectors.
components.css: .ds-tab-btn { padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'SF Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; font-weight: 600; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 2px solid transparent; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab-btn.ds-active { border-bottom-color: var(--accent); color: var(--fg); }

narrative.overview:
Loreweaver adopts a design system inspired by minimalist print layouts, academic documents, and high-quality physical notebooks. It rejects the floating, heavily shadowed interfaces of modern SaaS applications in favor of a flat, structured 'ink-on-paper' presentation. High contrast, precise layout grids, and clear typographical hierarchy ensure maximum legibility for Game Masters managing complex campaign information under low-latency or live play conditions.

The system is built on sharp, flat edges (0px border-radius), crisp border divisions (1px boundaries), and a dual-theme warm palette. The interface recedes to let the campaign contents—including handwritten notes and vector campaign map canvases—stand out as the primary visual focus.
keyCharacteristics: Flat-by-default surfaces and components with sharp corners (0px border-radius).
Dual-theme color system using warm paper tones for light mode and deep carbon tones for dark mode.
Strong editorial feel using classic serif display typography paired with clean, readable system sans-serif body text.
Outlined component styling with highly restrained use of solid colors, reserving the rust accent for focal actions and states.

rules.name: The 10% Accent Rule
rules.body: The Terracotta Rust primary accent must never occupy more than 10% of any view's surface area. Accent rarity preserves its capability to guide the eye to interactive focus states.

rules.name: The Ink Contrast Rule
rules.body: Interactive text must always contrast cleanly against the background. Do not use low-contrast grey on grey for important metadata.

rules.name: The Single Serif Rule
rules.body: Serif face uses are strictly reserved for Display titles and Markdown headings. All interface labels, menus, sidebar trees, and form elements must remain in sans-serif or monospace to prevent interface distraction.

rules.name: The Rest Restraint Rule
rules.body: No surface at rest may carry a shadow. Depth is communicated strictly by the 1px border lines (var(--border)) and contrasting panel background tones.

dos: Do align all layouts to sharp 0px corners, keeping borders strictly 1px solid lines.
Do reserve serif display faces strictly for main note title headers and H1/H2 markdown headings.
Do use the Terracotta Rust accent sparingly (≤10%) to highlight actionable items and active states.
Do support full dual-theme contrast ratios, ensuring text remains clean against warm paper/charcoal backdrops.
donts: Don't use border-radius values (e.g., 4px, 8px, or rounded pill shapes) on buttons, cards, or input fields.
Don't apply box-shadows to standard cards, cards at rest, or sidebars.
Don't introduce bright color gradients or saturated neon background fills.
Don't use low-contrast grey on grey text for important secondary metadata.
